clue.text: Gave zest to sort of bet I placed before backing last month

indicators.note: these words put the earlier pieces in front of what follows

parts.note: SP is starting price, the odds at which a bookmaker's bet is settled

indicators.note: backing means the month's abbreviation is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: December, the last month of the year, is abbreviated DEC

explanation.surface: A gambler livens things up with a bet made just after the year turns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns the month's abbreviation round. SP, the starting price, is a British racing term for the odds when a race begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To season food or a story is to add flavour or liveliness to it.

clue.text: Man subject to divine disposition.

parts.note: echoes the proverb 'Man proposes, God disposes': the human who puts forward plans that heaven then settles

explanation.surface: A theological remark about humanity being at the mercy of providence.
explanation.definitionFit: In the proverb, mankind makes the suggestions and God makes the final decisions, so man is the one who suggests.

clue.text: Forts rebuilt at El Cid's order

indicators.note: something rebuilt is put together again in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive s counts here as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: The Spanish hero El Cid commands that the castles be reconstructed.
explanation.walkthrough: AT EL CIDS rearranged gives the answer; 'order' finishes the surface as El Cid's command.
explanation.definitionFit: A citadel is a fortress, typically one guarding a city.

clue.text: Wretched document has a lost amendment inserted

indicators.note: inserted tells us one piece goes into the middle of another here

parts.note: a deed is a legal document

indicators.note: an amendment changes something, so the letters of these words are reworked

explanation.surface: A legal paper has had a missing clause put back into it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'amendment' rearranges 'a lost', and 'inserted' puts the result inside the legal paper; 'has' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Desolated means made miserable and forlorn, as wretched people are.

clue.text: Vessel takes corporal to Irish islands

parts.note: Corporal Trim is Uncle Toby's servant in Sterne's novel Tristram Shandy
the Aran Islands lie off the west coast of Ireland

explanation.surface: A boat picks up a soldier for a crossing to the west of Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corporal' looks like a rank to abbreviate, but it is Corporal Trim from Tristram Shandy.
explanation.definitionFit: A trimaran is a sailing boat with three hulls side by side.

clue.text: Spanish 'cape, old-fashioned, found in Tube station

parts.note: Cape Trafalgar is a headland on the south-west coast of Spain
a square is a person thought out of date and conventional

explanation.surface: A traveller notes that a Spanish cloak, rather dated, was left on the Underground.
explanation.walkthrough: Trafalgar Square was a London Underground station on the Bakerloo line until it merged into Charing Cross in 1979.
explanation.definitionFit: This was the name of a stop on London's Underground railway beneath the famous plaza.

clue.text: Old bird takes a snap of tribesman

parts.note: the moa is an extinct flightless bird of New Zealand
a snap is a quick bite, as a dog snaps

explanation.surface: An ancient bird snaps at a member of a tribe.
explanation.definitionFit: A Moabite was a member of the ancient people of Moab, east of the Dead Sea.

clue.text: Radio for official in case of bankruptcy.

definitions.meaning: a wireless set that picks up broadcasts
a person appointed by a court to manage an insolvent business

explanation.definitionFit: A wireless set picks up signals, and an Official appointed in insolvency takes over a failed firm's assets.

clue.text: He's unique, this. Lucerne type

definitions.meaning: a person without equal, a paragon
black medick, a plant of the same genus as lucerne (alfalfa)

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a paragon with no equal, and is also the name of a clover-like fodder plant related to alfalfa.

clue.text: Pacific coast resort

definitions.meaning: the Pacific Ocean was once called the ...
a seaside resort next to Portsmouth on England's south coast

explanation.definitionFit: The old name for the Pacific Ocean, and also a Hampshire seaside district of Portsmouth.

clue.text: Toucans dance, they say .

indicators.note: they say tells us the bird name is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: spoken, the bird name sounds like two cans, a pair of the word can

explanation.surface: Tropical birds are said to perform a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: Say 'toucans' and you hear 'two cans': CAN twice gives the high-kicking dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The cancan is a lively high-kicking stage routine from Parisian music halls.

clue.text: In play princess may tie up lamb

parts.note: to cord something is to tie it up with string
Elia was the pen name of the essayist Charles Lamb

explanation.surface: A farmer may need to tether a young sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lamb' is not the animal but Charles Lamb, who wrote as Elia.
explanation.definitionFit: Cordelia is King Lear's youngest daughter in Shakespeare's tragedy.

clue.text: Confines German within "" miles " of China

indicators.note: within tells us one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a li is a Chinese unit of distance, so Chinese miles are lis
mit, German for with, stands in for the German language here

explanation.surface: A German is restricted to within a few miles in China.
explanation.walkthrough: The German word for 'with' sits inside the Chinese 'miles'; the quotation marks around 'miles' are the setter's hint that it is a foreign unit.
explanation.definitionFit: Boundaries or bounds that restrict, as a noun; or restricts, as a verb.

clue.text: Go into action, having set fire to one entrance

parts.note: lit means set fire to
I is the Roman numeral one
a gate is an entrance

explanation.surface: An arsonist goes into action, burning a single doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'action' here is a legal action, a lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: To take a dispute to court is to start legal proceedings, an action at law.

clue.text: Neatly arranged to contain Indonesian island's social organization

indicators.note: to contain means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: trim means neat and tidy
Bali is an Indonesian island; the possessive gives BALIS

explanation.surface: A tidy plan to include Bali's community structure.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribalism is a society organised around tribes and loyalty to them.

clue.text: Circus'figure's resentful come-back?

indicators.note: a come-back sends the word for resentful back the other way

parts.note: sore means resentful or aggrieved

explanation.surface: A circus performer is bitter about a comeback.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circus is Piccadilly Circus in London, where the statue known as Eros stands.
explanation.definitionFit: The winged statue in Piccadilly Circus is popularly named after the Greek god of love.

clue.text: Makes amends for old Greek character — a final setback

parts.note: ex means former or old
pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: setback, read as set back, turns the word for final round

parts.note: set means fixed or final, as a date that is set

explanation.surface: A former Greek figure makes reparation for one last disappointment.
explanation.definitionFit: To expiate a wrong is to atone for it.

clue.text: Bovine halfwit a contradiction in terms ?

parts.note: oxy is a jokey adjective for like an ox
a moron is a halfwit

explanation.surface: A slow-witted cow seems a contradiction.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxymoron is a figure of speech joining words of opposite meaning, like 'deafening silence'.

clue.text: Perhaps Norman could produce, record I've lost

indicators.note: lost tells us some letters go missing from the record

parts.note: an archive is a record
the clue's contraction gives I, V, E

explanation.surface: A historian complains that Norman could produce documents, but they are gone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Norman' looks like a man's name; it is the round-headed architectural style, giving the Norman arch.
explanation.definitionFit: A rounded Romanesque arch is called Norman in English architecture.

clue.text: A soldier, Harry noted, took part in demo'

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
Harry Tate was a famous British music-hall comedian
D is a musical note, so noted adds a note

explanation.surface: A soldier called Harry observed a protest.
explanation.walkthrough: Harry Tate was a British music-hall comedian; 'noted' adds the note D.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitated as a verb means campaigned or protested publicly.

clue.text: Miss Harlowe is entitled to 'booking

parts.note: the heroine of Richardson's long novel gives her first name to the book's title

explanation.surface: A young lady has a right to a reservation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'booking' suggests a reservation; here it means a book named after her, Samuel Richardson's 18th-century novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Clarissa Harlowe is the heroine of Richardson's novel, whose title is her first name.

clue.text: Titivating for a party with the navy in Greek capital

parts.note: a do is a party
RN is the Royal Navy

indicators.note: capital means the first letter of the word Greek

explanation.surface: Smartening up for a party with sailors in Athens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek capital' looks like Athens; it is the capital letter of 'Greek', G.
explanation.definitionFit: To titivate is to smarten or decorate, as adorning does.

clue.text: Reduce length of a spanner

parts.note: a bridge spans a river, so it is a spanner

explanation.surface: A tool is used to shorten something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spanner' looks like the tool; it is anything that spans.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten it.

clue.text: Keep mum, oddly enough, in' rage shut up

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: ire is anger or rage

indicators.note: oddly suggests the letters of mum are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone told to stay silent while furious is ordered to be quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly enough' rearranges 'mum' and 'in' places it inside the anger word. 'Keep mum' looks like the definition but is not.
explanation.definitionFit: To immure someone is to confine them within walls.

clue.text: Districts where they are not satisfied with a pinta?

definitions.meaning: areas of a town, such as the Latin one

definitions.text: where they are not satisfied with a pinta?
definitions.meaning: a whimsical reading: people who demand quarts rather than a mere pint

explanation.definitionFit: Areas of a city are its sections; humorously, those who want quarts instead of pints.

clue.text: A tried form of abuse

indicators.note: to form is to shape anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tested type of insult.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirade is a long angry speech of criticism or invective.

clue.text: Searching examination in drug trial

parts.note: acid is slang for LSD
a test is a trial

explanation.surface: A thorough inspection takes place during a drugs trial.
explanation.definitionFit: A decisive test of worth, from the use of acid to test gold.

clue.text: What a time-server has to endure

definitions.text: What a time-server has to endure

parts.words: What a time-server has to endure
parts.note: a time-server is read as a prisoner serving time, who must undergo a court's punishment

explanation.surface: A complaint about what a careerist must put up with.
explanation.definitionFit: A prisoner serves the term of imprisonment a judge has passed.

clue.text: Crazy artists show state of India

parts.note: mad means crazy
RAs are Royal Academicians, artists

explanation.surface: Wild painters exhibit an Indian region.
explanation.definitionFit: Madras was the former name of the Indian state now called Tamil Nadu.
